title: Nimble Herbal Steamed Russian Datterini-tomato Borscht
description: A light and refreshing twist on traditional Russian borscht, featuring datterini tomatoes and a hint of herbal flavor.

ingredients.name: datterini tomatoes
ingredients.notes: any color, or a mix of colors

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh leaves, do not omit

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh leaves, do not omit

ingredients.name: fresh mint
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh leaves, do not omit

ingredients.name: beet juice
ingredients.notes: homemade or high-quality store-bought, do not omit

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: coarse sea salt, do not omit

instructions: Place 2 cups of water in the bottom of a bamboo steamer basket.
Add the steamer basket to a large pot with a lid, ensuring the water does not touch the basket.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the datterini tomatoes, sliced in half, to the steamer basket.
Steam the tomatoes for 8-10 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, combine the chopped fresh dill, parsley, and mint in a small bowl.
Stir in the bonito flakes, white vinegar, beet juice, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to make the herbal sauce.
Remove the steamer from the heat and carefully place the cooked datterini tomatoes in a large serving bowl.
Pour the herbal sauce over the tomatoes, tossing gently to coat.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
Cover any leftovers and refrigerate for up to 24 hours, reheating gently before serving.
